title: Data Usage & Licensing Policy (published as 'AI Data License Agreement')

parties.licensor: FutureBeeAI, which asserts that all datasets remain its sole property and retains all IP
parties.licensee: the Buyer/Licensee: anyone purchasing or using a FutureBeeAI dataset

permitted_use.value: Only the listed approved uses: AI/ML training and testing, academic research without public redistribution, product development, internal analytics, internal annotation/enrichment; anything else needs FutureBeeAI's written approval; a signed agreement overrides the policy.

ai_training_rights.value: Training, validating and testing AI models is expressly permitted (standard licence names AI/ML training); fine-tuning and benchmarking are not named separately; resulting models belong to the Buyer only so long as the original dataset is not exposed, distributed or shared; no redistribution of the data in any form; samples are evaluation-only before purchase; model outputs are not addressed.

field_of_use.value: Any lawful field within the approved use cases, excluding discriminatory AI, illegal surveillance and 'unethical' applications; no sector restriction otherwise.

exclusivity.value: Standard licence is non-exclusive and FutureBeeAI may sell the same dataset to others; an Exclusive License (no other party gets the dataset) is available by separate agreement and pricing; custom-collected data can be exclusive or non-exclusive per contract.

sublicensing.value: Not permitted: the licence is non-transferable and non-sublicensable, and resale, sharing or sublicensing of the dataset is prohibited.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: Insights, models and products derived from the dataset belong to the Buyer, conditional on not exposing or sharing the original data; internal annotation/enrichment allowed; an altered dataset may not be resold as a derivative dataset; FutureBeeAI keeps ownership of the dataset itself.

deletion_on_termination.value: FutureBeeAI may terminate immediately for violation; the Buyer must then delete all copies of the dataset; silent on whether models trained before termination survive.

warranties_by_provider.value: FutureBeeAI gives no warranty of any kind in the policy; the only quality remedy is that a Buyer whose dataset misses agreed specifications may request a resolution, with no guaranteed refund.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: No prices in the policy; no refund once a dataset is accessed or downloaded; refund before download at FutureBeeAI's discretion; exclusive licences priced by separate agreement.

governing_law.value: Laws of India; arbitration seated in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, unless otherwise agreed.

change_of_terms.value: FutureBeeAI may change the policy unilaterally at any time; material changes notified by email or website; continued use of the dataset is acceptance; a signed agreement overrides the policy.

prohibited_uses.value: No resale, sharing, sublicensing or public/open-source distribution; no discriminatory AI, illegal surveillance or unethical use; no resale of altered derivative datasets; no use violating GDPR/CCPA etc.; no ownership claims; breach allows immediate termination, damages action and blacklisting.

unknowns.note: The policy contains no warranty from FutureBeeAI that contributors or people depicted consented or signed releases; the only related words are the site banner 'ethically sourced' (marketing), while the policy puts GDPR/CCPA compliance of the Buyer's use on the Buyer.
No indemnity in either direction; FutureBeeAI only reserves a right to sue a violating Buyer for damages.
No limitation or cap on either party's liability and no disclaimer of warranties.
No mechanism for a data subject's erasure request or a takedown reaching copies already sold; the only deletion duty arises on licence termination for Buyer breach.
No stated licence term (perpetual or fixed); termination is described only for Buyer violation.
No audit or inspection right for FutureBeeAI; the Buyer must only keep reasonable security, limit access to authorised personnel and report misuse.
The policy treats every dataset as FutureBeeAI's sole property and does not distinguish own-collected, crowd-collected or third-party-supplied data, nor pass through any provider terms.
Silent on whether models trained before termination may continue in use once all dataset copies must be deleted.
